title: 第330章 天子佛子空道还活着第329章 发布通缉令
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着凌浩发布针对诛神殿的屠杀令后，这一道消息立马就传遍整个诸天万界
立马就让所有人都感到无比的压力
“你们收到凌家神子的屠杀令了吗，没想到同为人界巅峰势力的诛神殿居然被凌家的神子一人屠杀了，这是何等天骄”
“那可不，听闻当时凌家神子一人将整个诛神殿杀穿，无一活口就来低下的蚯蚓都被轰杀成尘埃”
一时间所有酒楼，饭馆都围绕着关于凌浩与诛神殿的事情展开
同样那些复苏的异族也收到了关于凌浩针对诛神殿的屠杀令
某一异族秘境内
”想来各位都知道了人界仙帝之孙凌浩的事情了吧“
为首的是一名身材魁梧的汉子，赤裸着上身目光犀利而霸道，在他的身前还有六名同样身材魁梧的汉子
蛮族当代族长蛮山，仙圣巅峰
“族长，我觉得我们应该与人界凌家合作，我们同为人族只不过是所生存的时代不同罢了，论根源我们都是一样的”
接着一名身穿蓝色裤子的魁梧汉子提出自己的建议
蛮族三长老蛮熬，仙圣中期
“我觉得暂时还不能合作，虽然我们同为人族根源，但对于凌家我们所了解的不多还需要继续观察，不过我们可以先让族内年轻一代的族人出去，试着与凌家神子接触”
一名穿着红色裤子的魁梧汉子接着说道，对于刚刚提出的与凌家合作他不反对，但为了族群安全着想，他觉得他们需要先了解凌家再考虑要不要和凌家合作
蛮族二长老蛮战，仙圣中期
“老红说的有道理，关于凌家我们知道的不多，确实需要先派弟子出去了解一下才行，关于这点诸位可有什么建议”
蛮族大长老蛮亢思索片刻后到，但同时又想到如果才能与凌家的弟子接触到
这一点是最重要的
“如今距离我蛮族的历练秘境即将开启，不然以此为由邀请凌家弟子前来一同探索如何？”
蛮熬思索片刻后道，他们蛮族的秘境内有着无数提升肉身的天材地宝，哪怕对方是帝族势力也不可能有那么多的淬体至宝
而这一点就是他们与凌家谈判的筹码
“我同意三长老的建议”
“我也同意”
众人在思索片刻后都同意蛮熬的建议，他们蛮族除了秘境内的淬体天材地宝以外能真正吸引到一股帝族势力的筹码根本没有
“居然各位都同意了，那么吾就将这道领旨发布全族”
接着蛮山就将刚刚商讨的事情公布到整个秘境当中
“众弟子听令，如今吾蛮族复苏于世间，吾族必不能被其它异族比下去，令尔等多出去挑战历练，但有一点不得与人界凌家弟子为敌，以友为准，如若彼此之间发生争执必须跑！”
一时间蛮山的声音响彻整个蛮族秘境，这让整体蛮族都感到震惊，他们不知道凌家是谁，但他们也要按照他们族长的命令行事
不得与凌家弟子发生争执
“同时我族也发布针对人界诛神殿的通缉令，杀一位诛神殿外门弟子赏一株下品淬体仙药，杀一位内门弟子赏一株中品淬体仙药和三株淬体仙药，杀一位核心弟子赏一株上品淬体仙药加一滴蛮兽本源精血，以上都上不封顶”
轰！
一时间整个蛮族秘境都发生震动，这一道通缉令下来整个蛮族族人都兴奋到了极点，所有人身上那股滔天气势充斥整个秘境
一脚踏地整个大地都发生震动，无数山峰都被震塌陷
content_en:
After Ling Hao issued the massacre order against the Temple of Punishment, the news immediately spread throughout the world.
Everyone immediately felt extremely stressed
"Have you received the order to massacre the divine son of the Ling family? I didn't expect that the Zhushen Temple, which is also the pinnacle of the human world, would be massacred by the divine son of the Ling family alone. What a genius this is?"
"No, I heard that the Son of God of the Ling family killed the entire Temple of Punishment by himself at that time, and all the earthworms that came to the lower level were blasted into dust."
For a time, all the restaurants and bars were focusing on the matter about Ling Hao and Zhushen Temple.
The same resurrected alien races also received Ling Hao's massacre order against the Temple of Punishment.
In a secret place of a foreign race
"I think everyone knows about Sun Linghao, the Immortal Emperor of the Human Realm."
The leader was a burly man, shirtless and with sharp and domineering eyes. In front of him were six similarly burly men.
Man Shan, the contemporary leader of the Barbarian clan, the pinnacle of the Immortal Saint
"Clan leader, I think we should cooperate with the Ling family in the human world. We are both human beings, but we live in different eras. In terms of origin, we are all the same."
Then a burly man in blue pants made his suggestion
The third elder of the barbarian tribe, Man Nao, is in the middle stage of the Immortal Saint.
"I don't think we can cooperate yet. Although we are both from the human race, we don't know much about the Ling family and need to continue to observe. However, we can first let the younger generation of the clan go out and try to contact the Ling family's divine son."
A burly man wearing red pants went on to say that he had no objection to the cooperation with the Ling family just proposed, but for the sake of the safety of the clan, he felt that they needed to understand the Ling family first before considering whether to cooperate with the Ling family.
The second elder of the barbarian tribe fights in the middle stage of the Immortal Saint
"What Lao Hong said makes sense. We don't know much about the Ling family. We really need to send disciples out to find out more first. Do you have any suggestions on this?"
Man Kang, the great elder of the Barbarian clan, arrived after thinking for a while, but at the same time he thought about how to get in touch with the disciples of the Ling family.
This is the most important
"Now that the secret realm of experience for my barbarian tribe is about to open, how about using this as an excuse to invite the disciples of the Ling family to come and explore it together?"
After thinking for a moment, Manao said that there are countless heavenly materials and earthly treasures that can improve the physical body in the secret territory of their barbarians. Even if the opponent is the imperial clan, it is impossible for them to have so many body-tempering treasures.
And this is their bargaining chip in negotiating with the Ling family.
······
"I agree with the third elder's suggestion"
"I agree too"
After thinking for a moment, everyone agreed with Man'ao's suggestion. Apart from the body-tempering heavenly materials and earthly treasures in the secret realm, the barbarians had no leverage to truly attract an imperial clan force.
"Everyone actually agrees, so I will issue this decree to the whole clan."
Then Man Shan announced what he had just discussed to the entire secret realm.
"Disciples, listen to the order. Now that our barbarian race has revived in the world, our race must not be compared with other alien races. I order you and others to go out and challenge more and gain experience. However, one thing is that you must not be enemies with the disciples of the Ling family in the human world. You must be friends. If there is a dispute between each other, you must run away!"
For a time, Manshan's voice resounded throughout the entire Barbarian secret realm, which shocked the entire Barbarian tribe. They didn't know who the Ling family was, but they had to act according to the orders of their clan leader.
Do not have any disputes with Ling family disciples
"At the same time, our clan has also issued a wanted order for the Temple of Punishment in the human world. If you kill an outer disciple of the Temple of Punishment, you will be rewarded with a low-grade body-tempering elixir. If you kill an inner disciple, you will be rewarded with a medium-grade body-tempering elixir and three body-tempering elixirs. If you kill a core disciple, you will be rewarded with a high-grade body-tempering elixir plus a drop of the original blood essence of the barbarian beast. There is no limit to the above."
Boom!
For a moment, the entire Barbarian Secret Realm was shaken. With this wanted order, the entire Barbarian tribe was extremely excited, and the turbulent momentum from everyone filled the entire Secret Realm.
As soon as I stepped on the ground, the whole earth shook, and countless mountain peaks collapsed.
title_en: Chapter 330: Emperor Buddha Kongdao is still alive Chapter 329: Issue a wanted order
